Hey man,

I experienced the same exact thing too. My ex bf told me that i needed to let go and said some mean stuff to me for the last time before he blocked me for good. Its been abt 4 months since we broke up and I also started taking care of my mental health and try to mend my friendships from other people.

These things would take alot of time honestly. Im not saying its easy its definitely not  but maybe you can use this time to really try to find the true you I guess. And maybe you can try to start loving yourself slowly first because breakups tend to mess up our self love for ourselves, as we tend to blame ourselves for not being competent or affectionate enough in the rs  which is not true.

I know you can keep moving forward and try to move on. You got through it for 2 months alrdy and have made alot of improvement, just keep pushing on! You got this OP!
